description: Sri Lanka Institute of Architects - Amendment of Regulations Made Under Provision of the SLIA Law No.01 of 1976
categorisation: This gazette content involves the repeal and substitution of a specific regulation (Regulation No.: 7.7.2 (3) (c)) under the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects Law, which constitutes a legal/regulatory amendment. It references specific legislation (Sri Lanka Institute of Architects Law No.: 1 of 1976 and Amendment Act 14 of 1996) and involves modifying the legal framework governing the professional institute, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) rather than government structure/personnel categories.
